captures.name: box
captures.title: One box over every session
captures.body: This searches what the agents actually said and did, not just the names you gave the runs. A session you never labelled is still findable by what it touched.

captures.name: before
captures.title: Start from the whole list
captures.body: Every session you have run is searchable, live ones and finished ones alike.

captures.name: text
captures.title: Search the transcripts, not just the titles
captures.body: A plain word is matched against what the agents actually said and did, so you can find a run by what it touched.

captures.name: facet
captures.title: Narrow by label, machine or status
captures.body: Typed filters like label:, machine: and status: combine with the free text to cut a large fleet down fast.
